title: gitleaf.yaml (gitleaf/config@1)
description: Workspace configuration at a repository root. Declares doc roots across repos, rules, forge settings and secret backends. Holds secret:// references only, never values.

roots.description: Where docs live. Each root is a folder, optionally in another repository.

appearance.description: Hints only. The user's gitleaf.appearance setting and installed packs decide.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes, no leading slash and no '..' segments.

secretRef.description: A reference to a secret in an external store. Never a value.

repo.description: Another repository holding this root: a path relative to this repo's parent folder, or a workspace folder name. Omit for this repository.

name.description: Display name for this root in the docs explorer.

owners.description: Whether every doc must declare owners in its frontmatter.

stale_after_days.description: A doc with no change for this many days is reported as stale. 0 disables the check.

frontmatter.description: Whether every doc must have frontmatter.

links.description: Whether broken relative links and wikilinks are errors, warnings or ignored.

forge.description: Where pull requests live. Credentials are references only.

url.description: Repository URL on GitHub or GitLab, or the project URL on Azure DevOps.

secrets.description: Which external store the secret:// references resolve against. Metadata only.

path.description: For sops: the relative path of the private secrets repo or file.
